title: Summer garden crickets
description: A separate summer-night cricket recording with a different call pattern and stereo space.
author: Defelozedd94
sourceDescriptionSummary: Summer-night garden crickets recorded with a Tascam DR-05; the creator removed storm background noise in Audacity. This new 40-second passage is independent from the legacy 8–28-second excerpt.
access: Public HQ MP3 preview, without login, account, or paid service; original WAV download requires Freesound login.
processing: Select source seconds 52–92; 1800 Hz two-pole high-pass to remove low background wash; fixed 10.956829 dB gain throughout, 5 ms click guards at both boundaries, 2-channel 44.1 kHz 192 kbps MP3. No added compression, AGC, limiting, noise gate, dynamic denoise, envelope riding, time/pitch change, artificial pulse, or added layer. Runtime circular overlap handles the loop seam. The downloaded public preview is retained byte-for-byte; original uncompressed source was not downloaded.

validation.scope: Signal measurements only; not a perceptual certification of source, dryness, or absence of musical content.

envelope.scope: Signal amplitude evidence only. Natural rainfall intensity and insect pulse gaps may vary; these measurements do not identify sources or certify perceptual absence of pumping.

listeningReview: Source-page descriptions, waveform and spectrogram inspection, and signal/envelope measurements; no human listening certification.
